faq.q: Where is the best area to stay in Uthai Thani?
faq.a: For a first visit, base near the town center and main transport — it is the most convenient for food and getting around. See our ranked roundup above for the best-reviewed hotels and their locations.

faq.q: How much does a hotel in Uthai Thani cost?
faq.a: Prices range widely by season and style. The quickest way to find the current rate is our ranked roundup, which compares the same hotel across Agoda, Booking and Trip.com.
